# Control fixture / 控件夹具

`controls.mix` is an authored derivative of `public/samples/glazed-ceramic.mix`, with additional standard exposed bindings `tint` → `tiles.colorA` and `blendMode` → `finish.mode`. It tests color/enum UI coverage; the three product material samples remain unchanged. JSON formatting is authored offline, never applied to user input at runtime.

`controls.mix` 是基于 `public/samples/glazed-ceramic.mix` 编写的测试变体，新增标准公开绑定 `tint` → `tiles.colorA` 与 `blendMode` → `finish.mode`，用于颜色／枚举控件覆盖；三个产品材质样例未变。JSON 排版在离线编写时处理，运行时不对用户输入进行此操作。
